title: Fondamantal — Broadcast Platform
label: Media Publishing / Brand Communication
summary: A brand-owned publishing channel for updates and announcements, designed for consistency, permanence, and platform cohesion.
overview: The Broadcast Platform is Fondamantal's first-party communication layer—centralizing announcements and updates outside third-party algorithm constraints. It provides permanent, brand-controlled messaging that integrates with the platform ecosystem.
problem: External social platforms bury content, limit presentation consistency, and reduce long-term accessibility of important updates. Algorithm-driven feeds prioritize recency over importance.
approach: Designed a lightweight publishing system for platform announcements
Built content permanence into the architecture—posts remain accessible indefinitely
Maintained brand consistency through shared design language
Integrated directly with the broader platform navigation
Created expandable foundation for categories and tagging
keyFeatures: Clear chronological structure for updates and announcements
Content permanence compared to ephemeral social feeds
Minimal UI keeping focus on the message content
Expandable foundation for tags and categories
technicalNotes: React / Next.js with reusable content components
Shared styling tokens with platform design system
Modern layout system for readable content presentation
outcomes: Reduced dependency on third-party distribution platforms
Platform identity strengthened through consistent messaging

gallery.caption: Chronological broadcast feed with brand-consistent presentation
Clean, focused reading experience for announcements
